description: Tuatara Summarize: extractive summary of a document. Returns the document's own sentences, chosen by a vector-association model, cut to sentence_count, a ratio of the sentences or a token budget; nothing is generated, so the summary cannot add facts. Use it to shrink long text before passing it to a chat model. Up to 200,000 characters per call; no account needed.

context_control.description: one word to steer the summary toward a subject

max_tokens.description: token budget for the summary (cl100k tokens)

mode.description: auto (default), faithful, gs1, gs2, best, tuned or tuned-best

order.description: document (default: original order) or rank (best first)

ratio.description: share of the sentences to keep, 0.05-0.9 (e.g. 0.2)

name: summarize_document
title: Summarize Document
